tools.name: cite42_recommendations
tools.description: Page-level AI visibility recommendations, for when the user asks how to improve a page. With a saved result (requestId, trackerRunId or evidence) it reports on one measured prompt, charged only when the report includes page-comparison advice backed by quotes from inspected pages. Without one: url alone runs a free technical check of the page (robots.txt crawler access, indexing, rendering) and returns suggested buyer questions; url with query first runs a citations check, priced like cite42_citations, then the report. Prices are in cite42_pricing. Fetches the page, its robots.txt and up to two pages the AI surfaces cited, as returned HTML without JavaScript. No site-wide crawl, keyword advice or tracker activation. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

tools.name: cite42_keywords
tools.description: Classic keyword data for a seed term. Omit ideas when the user only needs that seed's monthly search volume, CPC, or competition. Set ideas:true only when the user asks for related, alternative, or long-tail suggestions from provider candidates. Not a multi-model AI-search query. The reply echoes requestedKeyword and carries status "exact" or "no_data"; when the seed has no search volume, any related term that does appears under alternatives — never treat an alternative's metrics as the requested keyword's. Billed by outcome: cheapest when the seed has no search volume, more when it has metrics, most with ideas:true. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

seed.description: Seed keyword or concise topic to fetch search volume, CPC, and competition for.

country.description: ISO-2 country code for localized metrics. Defaults to "us".

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language code. Defaults to the country's primary search language, so country "de" searches in German. Only multilingual markets accept an override: us (en, es), ca (en, fr), in (en, hi). Every other country has a single search language and rejects anything else.

ideas.description: Omit for volume, CPC, and competition on the seed only. Set true only for related, alternative, or long-tail keyword ideas.

tools.name: cite42_tracker_create
tools.description: Create a draft weekly or monthly tracker: one measurement — rankings, compare, citations, or sentiment — applied to a list of prompts, with the brand, competitors and AI surfaces set once for all of them. Prompt lists can come from cite42_map_ai_prompts research. Creation does not start recurring calls. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates.

monthday.description: Monthly trackers only. Day of month 1-31; a value past the end of a shorter month runs on that month's last day, so 31 always means "month end".

primitive.description: What to measure on every prompt: rankings (which brands get named), compare (the brand against named competitors), citations (which sources are cited), or sentiment (how one brand is described). One measurement per tracker.

tools.name: cite42_tracker_activate
tools.description: Activate or resume recurring weekly or monthly tool calls. maxCostMicroPerRun must equal the tracker's latest estimatedCostMicroPerRun; activation authorizes future billed calls until paused. The response includes the balance, the cost per run, and runsDryAt, the date the balance stops covering active trackers. When tracker emails are enabled, activation sends a setup summary and every completed run sends current results and suggested next steps, even when nothing changed. Activation is refused when the balance cannot cover the next run. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates.
